source.title: Strabane Chronicle, 23 May 1964, p. 2 ("Two contests likely in Omagh Rural: Co. councillors get a clear field")
source.publisher: Strabane Chronicle (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: the full nomination list read in the Strabane Chronicle of 23 May 1964 and the Castlegore count in the Ulster Herald of 13 June 1964, cross-checked against the Irish News of 5 June 1964 (247 to 237, majority 10, electorate 544, total poll 485, one spoiled paper).

note: Triennial election of Castlederg Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. There was one contest, in Castlegore, the first in the district for thirty years; the other divisions were uncontested and are listed as the nomination report prints them. The returning officer's count at Castlederg was held on the night of the poll. H. McMenamin. Returned unopposed.
